keyframe_review.note: New keyframe (Cliopatria has no Yap row). The Yap page gives the island's land area as about 100 km2 (infobox) or 98 km2 (body); one grid cell. The outer islands of the tribute network are atolls with no land cell at the grid, so the drawn shape is Yap proper whatever the empire's reach; they are named in the region's text for the state page.

ledger.note: c. 950: Yap becomes the seat of the Sawei island empire. 'In circa 950 AD, Yap became the seat of the empire' (Gatcheper in Gagil); the page says the empire existed 'since around the 9th century'. The Yap page says the pre-colonial Yapese 'established an island empire and dominion' over the neighbouring islands, undated.

ledger.note: 1899: Yap passes from Spain to Germany. 'Spain sold Yap and its other minor Pacific possessions to Germany in 1899.' Bridging event: neither page dates the end of Yapese dominion; the Yap page also says 'From the 17th century until 1899, Yap was a Spanish colony', which contradicts an empire standing in 1899, and the Sawei tribute survived in part into the 1950s.

certainty.note: The island is exact; the reach of the tribute network is not a territory and is not drawn beyond Yap.

notes: A state Cliopatria lacks; drawn as a chiefdom's land. The Sawei page is thin and has no infobox; the 'Yapese Empire' is a tribute system (sawei/sawey) between Yap and the outer islands, so territory is the one island. Start c. 950 is the page's seat date; the end 1899 is a bridging choice (confidence 1) because no page opened dates the end of Yapese dominion, and the Yap page's 'Spanish colony from the 17th century' is not credible against an empire standing later and is left unreconciled. Not on any page opened: the traditional districts of Yap proper (Gagil, Tamil, Rull, Map, Weloy; only Gagil and Fanif appear), the Spanish claim of 1885, German administration's start (1899 sale only), the dates of the outer islands' tribute. Region names: Natural Earth's Yap admin-1 resolves to one cell; the outer islands as a region of the western Carolines (gazetteer_names_needed: Yap outer islands / Ulithi, Satawal, Lamotrek, Elato) are not in the gazetteer. Gatchepar coordinates approximate.
